gmd:title.gco:CharacterString: HUEN - ENTEBBE INTERNATIONAL AIRPORT - aerodrome (AD 2 scope)

gmd:abstract.gco:CharacterString: AIXM 5.1.1 aerodrome data set for Entebbe International Airport, covering the aerodrome, runways and runway directions, landing thresholds and declared distances, taxiway and apron areas, radio navigation aids, communication channels and aerodrome services. Assembled from open data; geometry for taxiways and aprons is derived from observed aircraft ground tracks held in this repository. Not for operational use.
